data.title: Algorithmic Bias In Recruitment: Evaluating Resume Screeners & Video Analysis (Yadav & Ahirwar, 2026)
data.summary: Reports that unaudited AI resume/video screeners produce a Disparate Impact Ratio below 0.72 for protected groups (improving to 0.88 once mitigation is applied), and documents proxy discrimination through indirect semantic associations with zip code, university tier, and employment-gap language. Caveat: published in the International Journal for Novel Research in Economics, Finance and Management, a venue not indexed in Scopus, Web of Science, or Google Scholar at the time this record was added — treat the underlying methodology as unverified even though the document itself states these figures verbatim.
data.citation: Yadav, K., & Ahirwar, K. (2026). Algorithmic Bias In Recruitment: Evaluating the Fairness and Diversity Impact of AI-Driven Resume Screeners and Video Interview Analysis. International Journal for Novel Research in Economics, Finance and Management.
